metadata.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock

problem_summary.summary: Choose one day to buy and a later day to sell, maximizing the resulting profit; return zero if no positive trade exists.
problem_summary.input_output: Input: daily prices. Return the maximum difference prices[sell] - prices[buy] for buy < sell, or 0.

brute_force.explanation: Try every buy day with every later sell day and retain the largest non-negative profit.
brute_force.correctness_idea: The nested loops enumerate all legal buy-before-sell pairs, so the best feasible transaction is considered.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(n^2) — every ordered pair of days is checked.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(1) auxiliary — only scalar indices and the best profit are stored.

optimized.explanation: Scan prices from left to right, tracking the lowest price seen so far and the best profit from selling at the current price.
optimized.correctness_idea: For a sale on the current day, the cheapest legal buy day is the minimum earlier price; considering this sale each day covers every possible optimal sell day.
optimized.time_complexity: O(n) — one pass through the days.
optimized.space_complexity: O(1) auxiliary — two scalar values are maintained.

steps.action: Initialize the lowest buy price to 8.

steps.condition: Selling at 3 gives -5; 3 is also a new minimum.
steps.action: Keep best profit at 0 and lower minimumPrice to 3.

steps.condition: Selling gives -2; price 1 is a new minimum.
steps.action: Keep bestProfit at 3 and update minimumPrice to 1.
Update bestProfit to 6 and return it.

edge_cases.handling: No sale improves the initial zero profit, so zero is returned.
There is no legal buy/sell pair and the method returns zero.
Either minimum gives the same best possible difference.
